title: Anchoring Bond between Ru and N Atoms of Ru/Ca2NH Catalyst: Crucial for the High Ammonia Synthesis Activity
extraction_notes: No main-text figures in this paper plot measured ammonia synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF. Figures 1–4 are STEM/particle-size distributions and XANES/EXAFS characterisation. The ammonia synthesis performance values appear only in Table 1 and text, which are outside this figure-digitisation pass.
